input.title: High order corporate crisis management
input.abstract: Much research has shown corporation managers generally to be unprepared for such crisis as political upheavals, kidnapping, dramatic changes in foreign exchange transactions, etc. Three related approaches to collecting and structuring information which warns of possible impending crises, or helps in their management once erupted are described: INFER, OPINT and EVAL. They draw on the experience of the US Department of Defence and intelligence agencies. © 1983.

output.reasoning: O artigo não atende aos critérios básicos de busca por palavras-chave do protocolo (métodos computacionais, lavagem de dinheiro ou crime organizado) nos campos de título, resumo ou palavras-chave dos autores.
